notes.title: Small update - bug fixes
notes.notes:
Hello, dear players.

We are here to inform you that we have made some basic corrections to this title.

Many players were reporting that achievements were often not being distributed, even if they finished the game. So our team worked to identify and resolve the issue.

We would like to inform you that, as of now, all achievements are working normally, and that they are distributed at the exact moment you perform the action for which the objective is to achieve it. If they are not distributed at the appropriate time, they will be distributed for sure at the end of the game.

We are working on further updates for all our titles.

If you have any suggestions, or want to report a bug/error, please send it to: publisher.gamesbraz@gmail.com

Or, if you prefer, post about a suggestion/bug/error in our community hub, here on Steam. We're always on the lookout.

Have a good game!
